newsitem.title: USA: Dominion group proposes to up shr value.
newsitem.headline: Dominion group proposes to up shr value.

text.p: The Committee to Revitalize Dominion Bridge Corp said Wednesday it had a set of proposals to improve the value of Dominion shares.
The committee proposes to buy engineering and contruction management firm First Key Project Technologies Inc. It said it is currently negotiating an acquisition agreement with the firm's principals.

The committee said acquisition of the Toronto firm, which it projects to post $12 million in pre-tax profits on over $150 million in revenues in the next 12 months, would bring an additional $50 million of fabrication work to Dominion's Montreal plant.

The committee also proposed that Dominion buy the remainder of its McConnell Dowell subsidiary. The buy-out would consolidate and strenghten Dominion's cash flow and make capital raising more efficient, the group said.
The committee also proposed Dominion issue shareholders contingent value rights for $2.50 per share.
The committee said it sent consent statement to Dominion's shareholders to approve the proposals last week.
On June 23 the group said it sent shareholders consent statements to remove Dominion's chairman Michel Marengere and other senior managers.
A Dominion spokesman said company officials were not immediately available for comment.

Dominion posted a loss of $1.5 million on revenues of $257.5 million for the six months ended March 31, compared with a profit of $4.2 million on revenues of $105 million in the same period the previous year.
Shares of the engineering company closed 7/32 higher at 1-13/16 on Wednesday. The stock began its slide from about $7 in December 1995.
